title: CDP Command Guide: Step-by-Step Howto
desc: CDP step-by-step: open, navigate, html, capture, eval-js, tabs, abnormal-tab recovery, error handling. See cdp-command-guide for quick-ref, cdp-command-guide-ref for full reference.
steps: FIRST STEP ALWAYS -- cdp open: wkappbot cdp open <url> returns OK {proc:'chrome',cdp:9300,hwnd:0x...,domain:'...'}. ONLY command that auto-detects/launches Chrome. SAVE the cdp:{port} from output.
cdp:{port} IN GRAP IS MANDATORY for all other commands: {proc:'chrome',cdp:9300}. Omitting it = error. Bare URL as first arg = error. Copy port from cdp open output exactly.
NAVIGATE: wkappbot cdp navigate GRAP 'https://example.com' -- waits for load. Reuses existing tab or opens new one if host changed. GRAP = {proc:'chrome',cdp:PORT}.
READ HTML: wkappbot cdp html GRAP -- returns full outerHTML for scraping/inspection.
CAPTURE: wkappbot cdp capture GRAP -- saves PNG screenshot, prints path.
URL+TITLE: wkappbot cdp url GRAP then cdp title GRAP -- returns current page URL or document title.
EVAL JS: wkappbot a11y read GRAP --eval-js 'document.title' -- a11y eval removed; always use a11y read --eval-js.
TABS: wkappbot cdp tabs -- list all tabs. wkappbot cdp close GRAP -- close current tab.
PORT FORMULA: SHA256(project-git-root)[0:4] % 174 * 4 + 9300, aligned to 0xFFFC. Same project = same port always. Wrong port = not in project CDP block error.

ABNORMAL TAB RECOVERY: If tab crashed (chrome-error://) -- cdp open auto-closes it and opens fresh tab. If tab unresponsive -- EvalAsync ping fails after 2000ms, tab closed and recreated. NEVER kill Chrome process for a crashed tab -- close only the bad tab.

ERROR RECOVERY: grap required -> pass {proc:'chrome',cdp:PORT} not raw URL. not in project CDP block -> wrong port, re-run cdp open. No node with given id -> DOM changed, re-run cdp html. CDP:DIALOG:BLOCKED -> JS alert auto-dismissed, command retried. LAT=ALERT -> clear with: wkappbot cdp eval GRAP 'window.onbeforeunload=null'
